column1: # Everyday and chat German for the glide and candidate engines: words a person types in a
# message that the AOSP corpus lacks or under-rates (ok, emoji, whatsapp, chat abbreviations).
# A boost only raises or adds; tiers: 200 greetings and replies, 180 messaging verbs, time
# words, chat, apps and tech, 165 colloquialisms and abbreviations (and any 2- or 3-letter
# slang). Letters only, no names, no obscene words; nouns keep the capital the list gives them.
